objective: Compose canonical created-at acquisition outcome analytics with exact quote-rate and bind-rate projection without adding SQL, persistence, rounding, or lifecycle inference.
rules: The created-at analytics application is invoked exactly once.
This composition layer performs no CRM or outcome persistence read directly.
CRM remains the owner of created-at cohort boundaries, ordering, and limit semantics.
INS-003S/T/U remain the owners of durable quoted and bound relationship numerators.
INS-003V remains the sole owner of exact quote-rate and bind-rate projection.
Zero-denominator rate omission remains owned by INS-003V.
No floating-point percentage or rounding policy is introduced.
